summary.current_path: Upload to parse to normalize to Lease Review is architecturally connected and suitable for controlled local or staging upload testing with explicit conditions.
summary.v3_path: Diagnostic/advisory only. Durable v3 scaffold, side-write, readiness, canonical layout, evidence anchors, and package graph exist, but no verified completed provider-backed v3 run is available.
summary.approval_path: Current approval workflow remains non-v3-gated. This is correct for No Gate, but not ready for evidence-based approval gating.

architecture_flow: parser provider: legacy or Azure layout
leases row linked to uploaded file
save draft / update field / approve workflow

component_status.role: Upload status and Open Lease Review handoff
component_status.notes: Uses pipeline-status, fallback uploaded_files query, and ensureLeaseReviewDraftForUpload. Stale failed_step is debug-only for review-ready rows.
Resolves existing lease id, searches linked leases, then calls server prepare flow.
Loads lease plus uploaded-file payload and uses normalizeLeaseReviewData. Auto-link fallback can search same-org uploads if source link is missing.

component_status.role: Single frontend projection and normalization layer
component_status.notes: Combines standard fields, dynamic rows, CAM/expense/rent/security fallbacks, clause records, readiness, and blockers.
Prevents assignment and unknown documents from inheriting full base-lease blockers.
Creates/updates pipeline jobs and dispatches the lease extraction worker.
Handles parse-normalize sequencing and durable status reconciliation.
Writes docling_raw and parser status. Parser provider is separate from business extraction provider.

component_status.role: Business output producer and optional v3 side-write
component_status.notes: BUSINESS_EXTRACTION_PROVIDER selects legacy_hybrid vs vertex_fact_ledger. ENABLE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_V3 controls diagnostic side-write.
Flag-gated and failure-isolated from legacy normalize.
Architecture exists, but no completed provider-backed real run has been verified.
No DB path; recent bounded invocation returned HTTP 502 and should not be retried without approval.

strong_points: v3 tables are org-scoped and read-protected by RLS policies
canonical projections are unique by run_id and field_key
side-write uses idempotency key when supplied
v3 side-write failures do not break legacy normalize

risks.risk: document_claim_evidence.uploaded_file_id can become null on uploaded file delete
multiple null idempotency keys are possible
reviewer decisions are primarily JSONB in leases.extraction_data.field_reviews
lease source linkage is mostly JSONB instead of an enforceable top-level relation

duplicate_paths.recommended_authority: legacy_hybrid remains default until scoped provider test succeeds
current authority is normalizeLeaseReviewData over current payloads; v3 remains advisory
current app uses JSONB map; row-table promotion needs a separate phase
persisted rules first, then structured workflow/fallback rows as needs_review

top_risks.risk: No verified completed provider-backed v3 run
Lease Review business rows still come from legacy JSON, not durable v3 claims
Source-file link can be missing and recovered by same-org heuristic
Runtime env and deployment alignment not verified
Fallback rows can be useful but not provider-confirmed
View Source behavior may not fully navigate to source document page
v3 schemas are diagnostic with some weak referential enforcement
Duplicate legacy and v3 paths can confuse product expectations

blockers_before_upload_acceptance_test: Confirm target environment and function versions match inspected code
Confirm frontend env points to intended Supabase project
Confirm pipeline-status is available for the test org and upload
Confirm ingest-file, lease-extraction-worker, parse-pdf-docling, and normalize-pdf-output are available
Confirm business provider remains legacy_hybrid unless scoped provider test is approved
Confirm uploaded_files.docling_raw, normalized_output, and ui_review_payload are populated
Confirm Open Lease Review creates or finds the correct lease row
Confirm Lease Review loads from linked source file, not same-org heuristic discovery
Confirm reviewer changes persist and reload
Confirm no v3 advisory result blocks approval
Confirm no secrets appear in browser logs or docs
blockers_before_controlled_production: Real provider-backed v3 run must complete successfully if v3 is part of production story
Durable claims, evidence, projections, validation drops, and package graph rows need real business validation
Reviewer decision authority must be documented or normalized
Source-file linkage should be enforceable and queryable without heuristic discovery
Browser E2E must prove upload to review to save draft to reload to approval handoff
Evidence view must open correct document page or source region
Assignment, base lease, CAM-heavy base lease, and unknown document behavior need staging coverage
RLS must be verified for user, admin, and super admin roles
Provider failures must return bounded sanitized errors
QA recommendation must remain No Gate until business users approve stricter v3 behavior

recommended_next_steps.description: Verify local/staging env, function versions, and frontend Supabase project.
Prove one current-path upload-to-review flow without production writes.
Make uploaded file to lease linkage explicit and enforceable.
Choose JSONB or lease_field_reviews as authoritative state.
Run one approved provider-backed diagnostic test only after explicit approval.
